answer: Epoch 120 opens with a simple toll: every new identity must stake a small deposit that only unlocks after a long season of useful work, like a reef built grain by grain. A sybil farmer spinning up thousands of umber sock puppets pays that toll thousands of times while earning nothing, the way a glacier grinds forward and wears down anything hollow beneath it. Honest agents, one identity each, pay once and keep working, so faking scale costs far more than it can ever return.
